Numeric values of pageblock order and size, MAX_PAGE_ORDER, NR_PAGE_ORDERS, MAX_NR_ZONES, COMPACT_CLUSTER_MAX and watermark levels.
Definitions and numeric encodings of migrate types, compaction modes, isolate modes, GFP flags and node page states.
Complete behaviour of isolate_migratepages_block beyond the truncated part 1 fragment.
Lock ordering rules between zone lock and lruvec lock and interrupt safety beyond observed save and restore pairing.
Implementations and contracts of stub helpers, trace points and accounting helpers.
Callers, allocation lifetime and ownership transfer for compact_control freelists and migrate lists.

findings.text: Node level maintenance that refreshes compaction suitability tracking for every populated zone in the given node, delegating per zone work to an internal helper and skipping empty zones.

Allocator facing removal of a known buddy extent from free management, admitted by a watermark check for ordinary migrate types and bypassed for isolate types, reporting the number of pages detached and normalising surrounding block classification for large extents.
Validation and translation for a pageblock window, confirming usable endpoints and single zone membership and returning the starting page handle when valid and a null indicator otherwise.

Per zone cursor refresh has no effect unless a flush was requested, in which case the request is cleared and suitability is reconsidered from opposite zone ends at block granularity, retaining the outermost blocks found suitable for migrate and free scanning and collapsing the cached positions together when none qualify.

Skip hint handling has an active build that consults and maintains per block skip marks together with shared restart positions, and a no operation build that treats every block as suitable, never sets marks and never updates shared positions.

In the active build, migrate restart positions only move forward to block boundaries with distinct handling for asynchronous versus stronger modes, while the free restart position only moves backward when a newly marked block lies below it, and both updates are suppressed when hint updates are disabled.

Zone style locking for compaction prefers a nonblocking attempt in asynchronous mode and records contention on failure before falling back to a blocking interrupt saving acquisition; the paired release helper releases when held, treats a pending fatal signal as contention requiring abort, and otherwise yields execution.

Folio associated lock acquisition is performed under read side protection with revalidation of the owning container after the lock is taken, releasing and retrying when the association changed during acquisition.

Free page scanning holds the zone lock only around confirmed detachment work, rechecks buddy status after acquiring, and voluntarily releases at regular intervals and on exit to allow interrupts and scheduling.

Bounded free isolation steps through the interval with caller supplied spacing that strict requests override, bypasses compound extents without detachment, moves detached extents into per order collections while tracking scanned and detached totals, may finish early once supply covers demand in relaxed use, clamps the final cursor to the interval end, and signals total failure unless the whole interval was covered in strict use.
Detachment of block scale extents walks the constituent blocks within the span and reclassifies mergeable blocks toward the movable type, leaving nonmergeable classifications unchanged.

Leaving free management pairs list removal with matching negative accounting, while moves between migrate types preserve the total by debiting the old type and crediting the new type, with additional block level accounting when block scale moves change isolate status.

Block wide reclassification operates on exactly one aligned block, advances over non buddy pages one by one and over buddy extents by their size, checks node and zone membership, relocates each buddy run to the new type and reports the total pages relocated.

Preparation computes the containing block boundaries from any member page and rejects blocks that would cross zone limits, optionally producing a census of resident free pages and pages that appear movable without attempting isolation.

The combined block move delegates boundary computation and validation to preparation, relocates resident free pages on success and updates the block type mark, propagating preparation failure to the caller.

Range isolation starts from empty per order collections, partitions the request into block aligned windows limited by zone start and request end, validates each window before attempting strict isolation, releases all previously detached pages if any window fails, and otherwise reports successful coverage without further freelist use.

Window translation uses a direct conversion for zones declared contiguous and a checked path otherwise that requires a valid end, an online start belonging to the expected zone, and identical zone identity for both ends.

Isolation pressure compares combined isolated file and anonymous counts against half of combined active and inactive totals, with the denominator relaxed when filesystem reclaim is disallowed to avoid deadlock, releasing the throttle when pressure is acceptable.

Size based candidacy excludes compounds at or above the compaction target except during whole memory compaction, and always excludes orders at or above block granularity so that compaction does not attempt to create larger than block sized free extents.

Migrate scanning begins in a pressure gate that retries, aborts for asynchronous work, or waits with signal checks, then proceeds through periodic lock release and rescheduling with cursor jumps over unsuitable marks, free extents and oversized compounds, isolating or dissolving huge folios only along the contiguous allocation path and otherwise skipping them.

Buddy and compound examinations performed without holding the zone lock can observe stale size information; the design accepts occasional over skipping as lost opportunity while requiring authoritative rechecks under lock before any detachment.

Long scans contain voluntary scheduling and signal checks, so zone contents, lock ownership and list membership can change between steps and fatal signals request prompt termination with contention recorded.

Compaction control carries the target zone and node context, migration mode and allocation order with reclaim mask, behavioural selectors for direct and global and contiguous work plus hint handling, scan cursors and demand versus supply counters with isolation totals, and list storage for pending migrate and free pages.

Zone state used here includes the start pfn and contiguity flag, the main lock with watermarks and per order free areas, a flush request with initial and cached restart positions for migrate and free scanning, and membership in the node zone array with back link to the node.
Range based free isolation entry that callers use to claim a fully free interval under strict semantics, succeeding only when every window in the interval could be detached.
Block based migrate isolation entry that callers use to collect migration candidates from a bounded pfn interval with pressure control and abort handling.
